en.setting: The Belgian Embassy stands behind an iron gate on a tree-lined avenue, its chandeliers burning against a November fog that pressed against the windows by eight o'clock. A diplomatic reception is underway, champagne circulates on silver trays, and the cipher office upstairs holds secrets that several nations would prefer to remain unread.
en.crime: Aldric Poel, a Belgian cipher clerk, was found seated in the conservatory during the intermission. His champagne glass was half-full, his eyes were closed, and he would not open them again.

suspects.name: Gregor Veronese
suspects.intro: An Italian diplomat who signed the guest register at 19:42 and whose jacket lining concealed a coded dispatch.

suspects.name: Marguerite Devaux
suspects.intro: Argued with Poel before intermission, stood near the orchids with her glass untouched and chalk on her gloves.

suspects.name: Sergeant Linden
suspects.intro: Embassy security, one hand on his radio, with a twelve-minute gap in his transmission log.

suspects.name: Commander Holt
suspects.intro: British military attache who asked about Baltic frequencies over dinner.

suspects.name: Daniil Orlov
suspects.intro: Press photographer whose camera held six frames of the cipher ledger shot from above.

suspects.name: Henri Maes
suspects.intro: The wine steward whose apron pocket held two small stoppered vials.

suspects.name: Eva Brandt
suspects.intro: Transferred from the Vienna office six weeks ago, her personnel file arriving three days late.

es.setting: La Embajada Belga se erige detras de una verja de hierro en una avenida arbolada, sus candelabros ardiendo contra una niebla de noviembre que presionaba las ventanas desde las ocho. Una recepcion diplomatica esta en curso, el champan circula en bandejas de plata, y la oficina de cifrado en el piso de arriba guarda secretos que varias naciones preferirian que permanecieran sin leer.
es.crime: Aldric Poel, un empleado de cifrado belga, fue encontrado sentado en el invernadero durante el intermedio. Su copa de champan estaba medio llena, sus ojos cerrados, y no volveria a abrirlos.

suspects.name: Gregor Veronese
suspects.intro: Un diplomatico italiano que firmo el registro de invitados a las 19:42 y cuyo forro de chaqueta ocultaba un despacho cifrado.

suspects.name: Marguerite Devaux
suspects.intro: Discutio con Poel antes del intermedio, de pie junto a las orquideas con su copa intacta y tiza en los guantes.

suspects.name: Sargento Linden
suspects.intro: Seguridad de la embajada, una mano en su radio, con un vacio de doce minutos en su registro de transmisiones.

suspects.name: Comandante Holt
suspects.intro: Agregado militar britanico que pregunto sobre frecuencias balticas durante la cena.

suspects.name: Daniil Orlov
suspects.intro: Fotografo de prensa cuya camara contenia seis fotogramas del libro de cifrado tomados desde arriba.

suspects.name: Henri Maes
suspects.intro: El sommelier cuyo bolsillo del delantal contenia dos pequenos viales con tapon.

suspects.name: Eva Brandt
suspects.intro: Transferida desde la oficina de Viena seis semanas antes, su expediente personal llego tres dias tarde.

fr.setting: L'Ambassade de Belgique se dresse derriere une grille en fer sur une avenue bordee d'arbres, ses lustres brillant contre un brouillard de novembre qui pressait les vitres des huit heures. Une reception diplomatique bat son plein, le champagne circule sur des plateaux d'argent, et le bureau du chiffre a l'etage garde des secrets que plusieurs nations prefereraient voir rester non lus.
fr.crime: Aldric Poel, un employe du chiffre belge, a ete retrouve assis dans le jardin d'hiver pendant l'entracte. Sa coupe de champagne etait a moitie pleine, ses yeux fermes, et il ne les rouvrirait plus.

suspects.name: Gregor Veronese
suspects.intro: Un diplomate italien qui a signe le registre des invites a 19h42 et dont la doublure de veste dissimulait une depeche codee.

suspects.name: Marguerite Devaux
suspects.intro: S'est disputee avec Poel avant l'entracte, debout pres des orchidees avec son verre intact et de la craie sur ses gants.

suspects.name: Sergent Linden
suspects.intro: Securite de l'ambassade, une main sur sa radio, avec un trou de douze minutes dans son journal de transmissions.

suspects.name: Commandant Holt
suspects.intro: Attache militaire britannique qui s'est renseigne sur les frequences baltiques pendant le diner.

suspects.name: Daniil Orlov
suspects.intro: Photographe de presse dont l'appareil contenait six cliches du registre de chiffrement pris d'en haut.

suspects.name: Henri Maes
suspects.intro: Le sommelier dont la poche de tablier contenait deux petits flacons bouchonnes.

suspects.name: Eva Brandt
suspects.intro: Transferee du bureau de Vienne six semaines plus tot, son dossier personnel arrive trois jours en retard.

all_strong.en: Gregor Veronese had switched the champagne glass during the toast, the compound dissolving without trace beneath the bubbles. The coded dispatch in his jacket, the tampered diplomatic pouch, the substitution cipher matching intercepted messages from October — each strand of evidence wound tight as a diplomatic cable. Poel had decoded three dispatches that named Veronese as the source, and by morning the name would have reached London. The fog concealed many things that evening, but not the truth.
all_strong.es: Gregor Veronese habia cambiado la copa de champan durante el brindis, el compuesto disolviendose sin rastro bajo las burbujas. El despacho cifrado en su chaqueta, la valija diplomatica manipulada, el cifrado por sustitucion coincidiendo con mensajes interceptados de octubre — cada hebra de evidencia se tensaba como un cable diplomatico. Poel habia descifrado tres despachos que nombraban a Veronese como la fuente, y por la manana el nombre habria llegado a Londres. La niebla ocultaba muchas cosas esa noche, pero no la verdad.
all_strong.fr: Gregor Veronese avait echange la coupe de champagne pendant le toast, le compose se dissolvant sans trace sous les bulles. La depeche codee dans sa veste, la valise diplomatique alteree, le chiffre par substitution correspondant aux messages interceptes d'octobre — chaque fil de preuve se tendait comme un cable diplomatique. Poel avait decode trois depeches designant Veronese comme la source, et au matin le nom aurait atteint Londres. Le brouillard dissimulait bien des choses ce soir-la, mais pas la verite.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Veronese's name surfaced from the guest register and the coded dispatch, but diplomacy has a way of blurring edges. The champagne compound was never conclusively identified, the cipher connection remained classified, and the fog that obscured the garden obscured the evidence as well. He was recalled to Rome under a cloud of suspicion rather than the weight of proof. The embassy filed the matter as unresolved, and the avenue returned to silence.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: El nombre de Veronese surgio del registro de invitados y del despacho cifrado, pero la diplomacia tiene una forma de difuminar los bordes. El compuesto en el champan nunca fue identificado de forma concluyente, la conexion del cifrado permanecio clasificada, y la niebla que oscurecio el jardin oscurecio tambien las pruebas. Fue llamado a Roma bajo una nube de sospecha mas que por el peso de las pruebas. La embajada archivo el asunto como no resuelto, y la avenida volvio al silencio.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Le nom de Veronese est apparu du registre des invites et de la depeche codee, mais la diplomatie a une maniere d'estomper les contours. Le compose dans le champagne n'a jamais ete identifie de maniere concluante, la connexion du chiffre est restee classifiee, et le brouillard qui obscurcissait le jardin a obscurci les preuves egalement. Il fut rappele a Rome sous un nuage de soupcons plutot que sous le poids des preuves. L'ambassade a classe l'affaire comme non resolue, et l'avenue est retournee au silence.

wrong_accusation.en: The wrong diplomat was detained, and Gregor Veronese passed through the embassy gate before the fog lifted. The coded dispatches continued, the cipher office remained compromised, and Aldric Poel's decoded work was quietly re-filed in a cabinet that no one checked. The conservatory was cleaned, the champagne glasses washed, and the Belgian Embassy hosted another reception the following month as if nothing had happened between the fern fronds.
wrong_accusation.es: El diplomatico equivocado fue detenido, y Gregor Veronese paso por la puerta de la embajada antes de que se levantara la niebla. Los despachos cifrados continuaron, la oficina de cifrado siguio comprometida, y el trabajo descifrado de Aldric Poel fue discretamente rearchivado en un armario que nadie reviso. El invernadero fue limpiado, las copas de champan lavadas, y la Embajada Belga ofrecio otra recepcion el mes siguiente como si nada hubiera sucedido entre los helechos.
wrong_accusation.fr: Le mauvais diplomate fut detenu, et Gregor Veronese franchit la grille de l'ambassade avant que le brouillard ne se leve. Les depeches codees continuerent, le bureau du chiffre resta compromis, et le travail decode d'Aldric Poel fut discretement reclasse dans une armoire que personne ne verifiait. Le jardin d'hiver fut nettoye, les coupes de champagne lavees, et l'Ambassade de Belgique organisa une autre reception le mois suivant comme si rien ne s'etait passe entre les frondes de fougeres.

cold_case.en: The fog never lifted on the Poel affair. Diplomatic immunity shielded the suspects, classified channels swallowed the evidence, and the Belgian government closed the file with a notation that satisfied no one. The cipher office was reorganized, the frequency lists changed, and Aldric Poel's name was removed from the embassy directory as quietly as the champagne had been cleared from the conservatory table.
cold_case.es: La niebla nunca se levanto sobre el asunto Poel. La inmunidad diplomatica protegio a los sospechosos, los canales clasificados se tragaron las pruebas, y el gobierno belga cerro el expediente con una anotacion que no satisfizo a nadie. La oficina de cifrado fue reorganizada, las listas de frecuencias cambiadas, y el nombre de Aldric Poel fue eliminado del directorio de la embajada tan silenciosamente como el champan habia sido retirado de la mesa del invernadero.
cold_case.fr: Le brouillard ne s'est jamais leve sur l'affaire Poel. L'immunite diplomatique a protege les suspects, les canaux classifies ont englouti les preuves, et le gouvernement belge a clos le dossier avec une annotation qui n'a satisfait personne. Le bureau du chiffre a ete reorganise, les listes de frequences changees, et le nom d'Aldric Poel a ete retire de l'annuaire de l'ambassade aussi discretement que le champagne avait ete debarrasse de la table du jardin d'hiver.

lucky_guess.en: Veronese was named on the strength of a guest register signature and a coat that smelled of nowhere in particular. The dispatch was found by chance, the cipher match incomplete, and the diplomatic community regarded the accusation as an embarrassment rather than a breakthrough. He was declared persona non grata and left Brussels on the morning train, guilty in all likelihood but proven in nothing.
lucky_guess.es: Veronese fue senalado por la fuerza de una firma en el registro de invitados y un abrigo que no olia a ningun lugar en particular. El despacho fue encontrado por casualidad, la coincidencia del cifrado incompleta, y la comunidad diplomatica considero la acusacion como una verguenza mas que un avance. Fue declarado persona non grata y salio de Bruselas en el tren de la manana, culpable con toda probabilidad pero sin nada probado.
lucky_guess.fr: Veronese fut designe sur la base d'une signature au registre des invites et d'un manteau qui ne sentait nulle part en particulier. La depeche fut trouvee par hasard, la correspondance du chiffre incomplete, et la communaute diplomatique considera l'accusation comme un embarras plutot qu'une percee. Il fut declare persona non grata et quitta Bruxelles par le train du matin, coupable selon toute vraisemblance mais sans rien de prouve.

expressions.suspect:gregor_veronese: Gregor Veronese adjusted his cufflinks before answering. His Italian was flawless but his pauses came at odd intervals.
expressions.event:champagne_compound: The champagne carried a faint bitter note beneath the bubbles. The compound dissolved without changing the colour.
expressions.motive:double_agent_exposure: The coded dispatches would reach London by morning. Once deciphered, the name behind the substitution key would be finished.
expressions.suspect:marguerite_devaux: Marguerite Devaux stood near the orchids with her glass untouched. Her argument with Poel had ended ten minutes before the intermission.
expressions.suspect:sergeant_linden: Sergeant Linden kept one hand on his radio and the other at his side. His log showed continuous entries except for twelve minutes.
expressions.suspect:commander_holt: Commander Holt asked about Baltic frequencies over the second course. His napkin was folded into quarters and placed on the left.
expressions.suspect:daniil_orlov: Daniil Orlov carried his camera openly, as press credentials allow. The lens cap was off during the aperitif hour.
expressions.suspect:henri_maes: Henri Maes polished each glass with a linen cloth before service. His apron pocket bulged with two small stoppered vials.
expressions.suspect:eva_brandt: Eva Brandt transferred from the Vienna office six weeks before the reception. Her personnel file arrived three days after she did.
expressions.location:belgian_embassy: The Belgian Embassy stands behind an iron gate on a tree-lined avenue. The fog pressed against the windows by eight o'clock.
expressions.location:conservatory: The conservatory opens off the east wing through a glass door. Fern fronds brushed the ceiling and the tiles were damp.
expressions.location:east_corridor: The east corridor connects the reception hall to the service wing. The carpet shows two sets of footprints in opposite directions.
expressions.location:reception_hall: Crystal chandeliers lit the reception hall in warm tones. The guest book lay open on a marble stand by the entrance.
expressions.location:cipher_office: The cipher office occupied a windowless room on the second floor. A desk lamp burned and the waste bin was empty.
expressions.location:service_pantry: The service pantry held three trolleys and a wall of glassware. A drawer beneath the counter was not fully closed.
expressions.location:embassy_garden: The garden path curved behind the conservatory toward the gate. Frost had settled on the bench and the gravel was quiet.
expressions.location:attache_suite: The attache suite was locked but the key hung on the corridor peg. A leather case sat open on the writing desk.
expressions.object:champagne_flute: A champagne flute rested beside the body, half-full. The lipstick on the rim did not match any female guest.
expressions.object:cipher_ledger: Poel's cipher ledger lay open to page thirteen. Pages fourteen through seventeen had been torn out along the spine.
expressions.object:torn_pages: Four charred page fragments sat in the conservatory fireplace. The ink survived enough to show column headers and partial numbers.
expressions.object:coded_dispatch: A folded sheet was found in Veronese's jacket lining. The text used a letter-shift cipher and referenced three dates in November.
expressions.object:vial_residue: A glass fragment the size of a thumbnail lay under the service trolley. The inner surface carried a crystalline residue.
expressions.object:guest_register: The guest register showed forty-one signatures in blue and black ink. Veronese signed at 19:42 in a slanting hand.
expressions.object:radio_log: The security radio log records transmissions at four-minute intervals. Between 20:15 and 20:27 the page is blank.
expressions.object:photograph_roll: Orlov's camera held a roll of thirty-six exposures. Frames nine through fourteen showed the cipher ledger from above.
expressions.object:embassy_key: A brass key to the conservatory was found in the steward's trouser pocket. The teeth showed fresh scratch marks.
expressions.object:glove_powder: White residue covered three fingers of Marguerite's evening gloves. Laboratory analysis identified it as blackboard chalk.
expressions.object:service_tray: The champagne tray held eight crystal positions in a brass frame. One position showed a ring stain but no glass.
expressions.object:diplomatic_pouch: A sealed courier pouch sat in Veronese's leather case. The wax showed a double impression where the seal had been lifted.
expressions.object:frequency_list: A handwritten list of Baltic radio frequencies was found in Poel's desk. The paper matched the stock used in the cipher office.
expressions.emotion:measured_calm: His breathing did not change when the body was mentioned. The champagne in his hand remained level.
expressions.emotion:averted_gaze: She turned toward the orchids when the inspector approached. Her fingers tightened on the stem of her glass.
expressions.emotion:rigid_posture: The steward stood with both arms at his sides during questioning. His collar was damp but his voice did not waver.
expressions.emotion:careful_phrasing: Each answer arrived after a pause of exactly two seconds. The words were chosen as if from a prepared list.
expressions.emotion:delayed_reaction: She heard the name and continued writing for three full seconds. The pen stopped mid-stroke on the fourth.
expressions.emotion:feigned_concern: He asked twice whether the doctor had been summoned. His eyes moved to the corridor door each time.
expressions.modifier:lipstick_mismatch: The lipstick shade on the glass did not appear on any guest. The colour was a discontinued Belgian brand.
expressions.modifier:tampered_seal: The diplomatic pouch seal showed two overlapping impressions. The wax had been softened and re-pressed with the same ring.
expressions.modifier:glass_missing: One position on the service tray was empty with a wet ring. The missing glass was not among those collected.
expressions.modifier:burned_fragments: The fireplace held fragments of four pages, curled and blackened. One corner preserved the word 'frequencies' in Poel's hand.
expressions.modifier:fog_thickness: Visibility outside the embassy dropped to fifteen metres after eight. The gate guard could not see the garden bench.
expressions.modifier:corridor_locked: The east corridor door was locked from the service side at 20:10. The key hung on a hook beside the pantry.
expressions.modifier:substitution_cipher: The coded dispatch used a letter-shift of seven positions. The same shift appeared in two intercepted messages from October.
expressions.modifier:fresh_ink: The ink on the dispatch was still tacky when examined at 21:00. The paper had been written within the previous three hours.
expressions.modifier:wax_impression: The wax bore the imprint of a signet ring with a laurel motif. Veronese wore such a ring on his left hand.
expressions.modifier:chalk_residue: The chalk on Marguerite's gloves matched the blackboard in the embassy classroom. She had tutored French that afternoon.
expressions.action:pages_torn: Four pages were torn from the spine with force. The remaining stubs showed uneven edges and traces of haste.
expressions.action:glass_switched: One champagne glass was removed from the tray before the toast. A second glass, prepared earlier, was placed in its position.
expressions.action:corridor_crossed: Two sets of footprints crossed the east corridor carpet. One set matched leather soles and the other matched rubber.
expressions.action:dispatch_concealed: The coded dispatch was folded into the jacket lining through an interior seam. The stitching had been opened and re-sewn.
expressions.action:camera_confiscated: Orlov's camera was confiscated at the garden entrance by Sergeant Linden. The film had already been advanced past frame fourteen.
expressions.action:toast_raised: The ambassador raised the first toast at 20:08. All guests stood and the steward circulated with the tray.
expressions.action:pouch_opened: The diplomatic pouch was opened without breaking the outer strap. The wax seal was the only barrier and it had been compromised.
expressions.action:ledger_photographed: Frames nine through fourteen on the film show the cipher ledger. The angle is consistent with the cipher office desk.
expressions.action:vial_discarded: A small glass vial was dropped beneath the service trolley. The stopper was missing and the interior was dry.
expressions.time:intermission_hour: The intermission began at 20:30 and was scheduled for twenty minutes. The body was found at 20:41.
expressions.time:fog_descended: Fog settled over the avenue at approximately 19:50. By the time of the toast, the garden was invisible from the windows.
expressions.time:guest_arrival: Guests began arriving at 19:00 and the last signature was recorded at 19:58. The doors were sealed for security after eight.
expressions.time:radio_gap: The security radio logged no transmissions between 20:15 and 20:27. Sergeant Linden stated he was checking the east corridor.
expressions.time:body_found: A kitchen porter entered the conservatory at 20:41 to retrieve a tray. The body was seated upright in a wicker chair.
expressions.motive:cipher_seizure: Poel had decoded three dispatches that referenced an internal source. The source was identified by a codename matching Veronese's frequency.
expressions.motive:diplomatic_leverage: Commander Holt sought leverage over the Belgian cipher operation. Access to the frequency list would give London a significant advantage.
expressions.motive:handler_payment: Bank records in Vienna showed monthly deposits to an unnumbered account. The amounts matched the schedule of Eastern dispatches.
expressions.motive:career_protection: Eva Brandt's transfer from Vienna coincided with a leak investigation. Her clearance was provisional and under quarterly review.
expressions.motive:blackmail_pressure: A letter in Poel's desk referenced an unnamed diplomat whose cover was expiring. The tone was urgent and the handwriting was Poel's.
expressions.witness:wine_steward: The wine steward carried four trays between the pantry and the hall. He passed the conservatory door twice and heard nothing.
expressions.witness:coat_check_girl: The coat check girl noted arrival times in a small notebook. She recorded Veronese at 19:41, one minute before the register.
expressions.witness:gate_guard: The gate guard locked the entrance at 20:02 and did not reopen it. He saw no one leave through the garden after the fog.
expressions.witness:kitchen_porter: The kitchen porter entered the conservatory to collect a drinks tray. He found the man seated and still, with the glass beside him.
expressions.witness:driver: The embassy driver waited in the forecourt until 22:00. He saw Sergeant Linden cross the garden at approximately 20:20.
expressions.event:aldric_poel_discovered: Aldric Poel was found seated in the conservatory during the intermission. His champagne glass was half-full and his eyes were closed.
expressions.event:intermission_recess: During the intermission, guests moved between the hall and the corridor. The conservatory was accessible through an unlocked glass door.
